proof:
intro N inst p j i
classical
unfold M6.Physical.conv M6.Physical.delta
rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (i - j)]
· simp
· intro r hr hne
  have h : i - r ≠ j := by
    intro heq
    apply hne
    calc
      r = i - (i - r) := (sub_sub_cancel i r).symm
      _ = i - j := congrArg (fun x => i - x) heq
  simp [h, Ne.symm h]
· simp
